groups.title: Phase I- Dose Level 1
groups.description:
Osimertinib (AZD9291) will be given at a 80mg/day dose taken orally across all levels of the dose escalation schedule.

Dasatinib is taken orally and will be given at Level 1 (the starting dose - 50 mg twice daily) There is no limit to the number of cycles a patient can receive. The phase II portion of the study will use the maximum tolerated dose of dasatinib determined in the phase I portion. Osimertinib (AZD9291) will be given at the same 80mg dose as the phase I portion.

Dasatinib: oral every day Osimertinib: oral every day
